$comment: The ledger for the Audio Implementer's loop (see ../CONTEXT.md). One entry per
sound slot, from proposed through implemented. This file is the whole state
machine — don't keep status anywhere else.
id             (required) kebab-slug, unique. The staged filename stem must match it.
category       (required) one of the categories/*.md files, by filename stem
interaction    (required) the file:line or scene+trigger this sound plays on
description    (required) what the sound should be/do, for the human making it
proposedAt     (required) ISO date the slot was proposed
file           (optional) the staged filename, set when status becomes staged
implementedAt  (optional) file:line of the wired call, set when status becomes implemented
notes          (optional) rejection reason, or anything the human should know
